# RequestedGreen

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Dialogs](BlitzPlus-Dialogs)

```blitzbasic
RequestedGreen  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** BlitzPlus

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** The green part, 0 to 255, of the color the last [RequestColor](RequestColor) picked. 0 before any color was picked.
